node.statement: For X=[X_pq] in M_n tensor B, the defining matrix product gives [g_n(I_n tensor B_j,X)]_pq=g(B_j,X_pq), and then [sum_j v_n(I_n tensor A_j)g_n(I_n tensor B_j,X)]_pq=w_prime(X_pq). The adjoint rule gives the same identity for w_doubleprime. Therefore the correction constructed at every level is exactly I_n tensor w and v_n^+=I_n tensor v^+; no level-dependent choice is made.
